# Copilot Instructions

This project maintains AI-oriented persistent context in the `.ai/` directory
at the repository root. When working in this codebase, read the files in that
directory to understand the architecture, design decisions, and conventions
established during previous AI-assisted development sessions.

When creating or updating any plan, memory, design note, or persistent context
file for this project, always place it under `.ai/` as the base directory.
Do not scatter such files into repo memory (`/memories/repo/`), session memory,
or other locations — keep everything centralized in `.ai/`.
